item.title: The Campaign Against Russell Brand is Gathering Steam, From New Netflix Hit Job, to Censorship Calls | Ep. 1442 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly discusses the breaking news that Russell Brand is being investigated by UK authorities over a message from Russell that his wife read, whether it broke prison rules to put out information and statements, the targeting of Brand by so many in the UK, the push to deplatform Brand going back years, the UK trying to eliminate him from the internet, the effort to cancel anyone who supports him at all like musician Ian McNabb, a new documentary showing why Brand is really being targeted, how all the allegations against him after he took on the global elite, the new Netflix "documentary" about Brand that is a fake hit job, the details about a new alleged victim whose story doesn't add up, an actress crying while pretending to be one of Brand's real victims, the way the dishonest filmmakers are ignoring the rules of honest journalism, the woman "Alice" featured in the 2023 "doc" going public with her real identity now, her claims of being a victim as a 16-year-old, the serious questions about why she wasn't part of the actual trial, the new alleged “victims” of Brand coming forward with ridiculous stories, how they aren’t even claiming that something illegal happened between them and Russell, and more.
